analysis.summary: This message is a classic phishing scam attempting to steal your One-Time Password (OTP) and gain unauthorized access to your bank account by creating a false sense of panic.

red_flags.detail: It uses the word 'URGENT' to panic you so you act quickly without thinking.
It asks you to send your OTP, which banks and legitimate companies will never ask for.
It claims your bank account is blocked without naming which bank or providing any proof.

claims_to_verify: Your bank account is currently blocked.
The person messaging you is a representative of your bank.
